authority: Mechanistic replay of previously studied games; no new holdout/model/default qualification

plan.authority: Mechanistic replay of seven previously studied games; not a new blind/unseen holdout or coupling model
plan.shift: Nonzero cyclic within-seed shift from SHA256(dst-alignment-diagnostic-v1:<seed>); same shift for both DSTs

study.control: Fixed shared nonzero cyclic shift within each seed; no fitting or independence guarantee
study.scoring: Three declared joint-event Briers, not a complete joint-distribution score

limitations: Seven previously studied retrospective games, not independent unseen validation. Games are aggregation units, not fourteen independent pairs or thousands of observed games.
Within-seed shifts preserve exact DST samples/marginals and the two-DST block relationship, but do not guarantee independence or zero correlation.
Three fixed threshold-event Briers do not validate the complete joint distribution; all events and their observed support are disclosed.
Marginal CRPS is exactly invariant to the control, so its previous change cannot measure correlation quality. No alternative coupling or coefficients are fitted.
Original sources, pregame evidence, selected-score coverage, cross-export conflicts and final source/model/database checks remain enforced. No production defaults changed.
